ios.desc:
Your AI conversations deserve privacy.

Onera is the secure way to chat with your favorite AI models. Every message, every note, every credential is protected by end-to-end encryption, so only you can read them.

All Your AI Providers in One Place

Connect to 13+ AI providers including OpenAI (ChatGPT), Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, and more. Switch between models mid-conversation or use your own API keys. One app, unlimited possibilities.

True End-to-End Encryption
Unlike other AI apps, Onera encrypts your data before it leaves your device. Not even we can read your conversations. Your chats are protected by the same military-grade encryption used by secure messaging apps.

Unlock Your Way

Choose how you secure your vault:

- Face ID & Touch ID with Passkeys
- Password protection
- 24-word recovery phrase
 - Device-based authentication

Smart Features, Private by Design

- Voice input with speech-to-text
- Listen to responses with text-to-speech
- Attach images, PDFs, and documents
- Explore alternative responses with branching
- Edit messages and regenerate answers
- Auto-generated conversation titles

Encrypted Notes
Keep sensitive notes alongside your AI chats. Organize with folders, pin important notes, and search across everything, all encrypted.

Beautiful & Intuitive
A polished interface with smooth animations, dark mode support, and gesture-driven navigation. AI conversations have never felt this good.

Why Onera?

- Zero-knowledge architecture, we can't see your data
- Your API keys stay encrypted on your device
- No tracking, no ads, no compromises
- Sync securely across devices with onera.chat

Download Onera and take control of your AI conversations.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Onera – end-to-end encrypted AI chat

quotes.text:
Hi HN, we built and open-sourced a privacy-focused AI chat client.

The goal is simple: the server should not be able to read your chats or access your LLM API keys, even if it’s fully compromised.

Most AI chat tools proxy everything through their backend in plaintext. We wanted something closer to a zero-knowledge design, like a password manager or Signal.

How it works:

- All messages, attachments, history, and API keys are encrypted on-device
- The server only stores encrypted blobs
- Prompts go directly from your browser/device to the model provider (BYOK), not through us
- Native iOS + Android apps
- Passkeys/WebAuthn support

For higher-risk deployments, you can optionally run the backend inside TEEs/enclaves for extra isolation and remote attestation, so even the infrastructure operator can’t inspect memory.

Stack: React, Hono + tRPC, PostgreSQL, Bun.

We built this because we use multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, etc.) and didn’t want prompts logged or keys sitting on someone else’s server.

GitHub: https://git.new/onera
Hosted version: https://onera.chat (free during alpha)
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/onera-private-ai-chat/id6758128954

Would love feedback on the design or threat model. Happy to answer questions.
